Import GPX waypoints and tracks from a GPS mounted as a volume

Source: R/bag_gpx_import.R
bag_gpx_import.Rd

Reads GPX files from one or more directories — typically a Garmin unit mounted over USB — filters them to a time window, tags each feature's name with a surveyor string so names from different units do not collide, and writes the result as both GPX and a GeoPackage layer.

Usage

bag_gpx_import(
  dir_gpx_waypoints = "/Volumes/GARMIN/Garmin/GPX/",
  dir_gpx_tracks = c("/Volumes/GARMIN/Garmin/GPX/Archive/",
    "/Volumes/GARMIN/Garmin/GPX/Current/"),
  dir_out,
  time_start = NULL,
  time_end = NULL,
  layer_output_name,
  gpkg_name,
  dates_view = FALSE,
  gpx_layer_type = c("waypoints", "tracks", "track_points")
)

Arguments

dir_gpx_waypoints

character Directory holding the GPX waypoint files.

dir_gpx_tracks

character One or more directories holding the GPX track files.

dir_out

character Directory to write to. Created if absent. Required.

time_start, time_end

character Inclusive bounds on the waypoint creation time and on the end time of each track, as "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS". Interpreted as UTC, which is the zone GPX records times in. NULL (the default) applies no bound on that end.

layer_output_name

character Appended to every feature name and to each output layer name, so that names from different units or surveyors stay distinct — for example "2026_ai". Required.

gpkg_name

character Base name of the output GeoPackage, without the extension. Required.

dates_view

logical Print the available times and write nothing. Default FALSE.

gpx_layer_type

character Which GPX layers to read. One or more of "waypoints", "tracks" and "track_points".

Value

NULL, invisibly. Called for the files it writes.

Details

Set dates_view = TRUE to print the times available in the files and write nothing. That is the way to choose time_start and time_end without guessing.

See also

Other download: bag_url(), bag_wfs()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# see what is on the unit before choosing a window
bag_gpx_import(
  dir_out = "~/gps",
  layer_output_name = "2026_ai",
  gpkg_name = "gps_2026",
  dates_view = TRUE
)

bag_gpx_import(
  dir_out = "~/gps",
  layer_output_name = "2026_ai",
  gpkg_name = "gps_2026",
  time_start = "2026-01-01"
)
} # }
